new: Areas: one shared room can have tape crosses in several areas. A headset lined up by its own crosses adds an area (Room setup, Areas: a name, then its two crosses C and D, E and F, ...). Any headset can calibrate on the crosses of whichever area it is in, and it stays in the same room. Walking from one area to another, it lines up again from that area's crosses by itself and the check by eye asks.

Anchors: every area's place keeps two anchors while 8 fit (7 with Anchor on). Once more are needed, the places made first go down to one anchor each, the oldest first; past that the place used least recently goes. A notice says which. This replaces v130's Anchors per room setting.
Join pressed on the 'you are standing in another room's place' offer now counts as joined by its place, so the next move between rooms can happen by itself.

Studio, editing: nothing is drawn see-through any more. A model or shape a cube hides from you is an outline box with its name and 'hidden', and is drawn whole and solid while you hold it. Trigger cubes and shapes that hide things show only their edges. Ghosts are solid light grey, or an outline box for a model its own animation moves. Cut-outs, tags and markers are solid.

Studio, editing: every model and shape shows its triangles next to its name in space (e.g. 'Atelier · 397k ▲'), following Fewer triangles while you preview. The pointed-at and selected labels say it too.

Occlusion after a sleep: when the headset wakes after 10 s or more, or depth or the room scan stops coming, the app asks again for the depth and builds the room again. If that does not bring them back after a few tries, the Debug tab's Real world line and a notice say to leave AR and enter again.
test: Areas: in one room, add a second area 10 m or more from spots A and B (Room setup, Areas), with a headset calibrated on A and B. Calibrate a second headset only on the new area's crosses: both should be in the same room, and Check at A on the second should come out green or amber.

Walk with one headset from one area to the other in one session: does it line up from the new crosses by itself (the check by eye asks why), and do the crosses there carry that area's letters and name? Forget area on the Debug tab.
With more than four areas (or rooms) calibrated, the oldest places should go down to one anchor (a notice says so); come back to one of them next session: do the crosses still sit on the tape?

Studio on a Quest, editing on, with a big scan hidden by a cube and while standing inside a cube: turn on the frame rate (double press B or Y) and compare with v130. Grab a hidden model: whole and solid while held, an outline again once let go. Do the triangle tags read well?

Occlusion: in AR let a Quest 3 or 3S sleep a few minutes, then wake it. Do people and the room still hide things? If not, what does the Debug tab's Real world line say, and does leaving AR and entering again fix it?
untested: Everything on a real headset: how far the room's frame drifts on the walk to a new area (the new crosses are measured there), whether a Quest finds an area's anchors as you walk in or only at a session's start, and whether a place on one anchor keeps its turn between sessions.
The frame-rate gain in the studio on a Quest, and how the outline boxes, edge-only cubes and shapes, grey ghosts and solid tags read life size.
Whether asking again really brings a Quest's depth and room scan back after a long sleep (leaving AR and entering again stays the proven remedy), and a lost WebGL context in a session.
Trackers lined up by hand on an area with real SteamVR, and camera mode on an area on a real phone.
On dev only the quick checks ran (the lanes ran their own blocks); the full suites run before the main site moves.
